question: What rules and numbers do the persistence expression graphs hold about experience and stat counting?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/persistence.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Passive mastery experience (`ActSimEx_Persistence_PlayerOwner`, 0x17304 to 0x17b00): off when kill switch `DisablePassiveMasteryXP` is set; ticks every `PassiveMasteryXP_Interval` seconds only while firing or within 10 s of the last shot; amount = scalar x interval / 60, scalar chosen for vehicle, secondary or primary (anything else uses primary).

Battle royale placement experience (`SimEx_Persistence_OutcomeXPBonus_Granite` and the losing-squads variant): budget per mode (solo, duo, trio, squad) x `BR - MatchPlayed_PlacementWeights`[placement - 1] / sum of weights, divided by 100, truncated, x 100.
Match-time experience per minute is chosen by game mode: `Override_MatchPlayed_XPpM` when non-zero, else `All - MatchPlayed_XPpM`.
Multi-kill timeout is chosen by chain length: 1 uses `MultiKill2`, 2 `MultiKill3`, 3 `MultiKill4`, otherwise `MultiKill5`. `QuickDrawTimeout_Seconds` applies only to one weapon group.
Survival bonus experience is read from an array at index teams alive - 1, per battle royale sub-mode.
Capture-point time events fire from a per-soldier accumulator at the `ObjectiveSecuring`, `Holding` and `Controlling` trigger intervals.
`OnGraniteWin` reads the win streak unless kill switch `Granite_IgnoreWinStreak` is set.
Areas-visited tracking uses a 60 constant (read as seconds).

inference: The truncation in the placement formula and the number of squads summed are inferred from unnamed functions.
Unnamed functions `ef511eac`, `77d2b6e0`, `a46ea4fe`, `c22c64f8`, `f78bc893`, `3c643507` were read from context as floor, subtract and comparisons.
unresolved: Event identifiers are packed in the arguments of undecoded native calls, so which stat each event increments is not read.
Experience amounts and all named tunables are stored elsewhere.
The player graph was not read instruction by instruction.
One listing (`playerobjectiveprogress`, around 0x6d0 to 0x78c) is damaged by a decode slip.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Persistence graphs read: they emit stat and experience events and hold almost no amounts; passive mastery experience ticks only within 10 s of firing and is scaled by interval / 60, and battle royale placement experience is a weighted share of a per-mode budget rounded down to 100
leads.summary: The 46 persistence graphs were read (the 2,700-line player graph by section, not line by line). They are event emitters: a gate, then a native call that fires an event. Experience amounts, multipliers and caps are not in them. Two formulas are present: passive mastery experience (per interval, only while firing or within 10 s of the last shot, amount = scalar x interval / 60) and battle royale placement experience (budget x weight for the placement / sum of weights, rounded down to a multiple of 100). 9 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: Experience amounts are needed: join the named tunables, or decode the event argument packs.
leads.statusNote: Persistence graphs read at reader level; constants raw-checked.
